I have system design round for tier 1 startup, but don't know system design much, how to prepare and guidance? 15 days left

Since you have 15 days, focus on the fundamentals first. Start with client-server architecture, load balancers, databases, caching (Redis), message queues, sharding, replication, and microservices.

Follow the System Design Primer on GitHub and ByteByteGo on YouTube.

Once your basics are clear, practice designing common systems like URL Shortener, Instagram, WhatsApp, Uber, and YouTube.

Also, understand SQL vs NoSQL, CAP theorem, consistency, scalability, and fault tolerance.

Don't just watch videos. Try drawing the architecture yourself and understand why each component is needed. Practice explaining your design out loud.

Focus more on HLD, and cover basic LLD (OOP, SOLID, design patterns) as well.
